# Scala-Man

## Requirements

- Java 21 or later
- The JAR matching your operating system

Check the installed Java version:

```bash
java -version
```

## Run Scala-Man

Open a terminal in this directory and run the command for your operating system.

### Linux

```bash
java -jar scala-man-linux-fat.jar
```

### macOS

```bash
java -jar scala-man-macos-fat.jar
```

### Windows

```powershell
java -jar scala-man-windows-fat.jar
```

If `java -version` reports a version older than 21, install Java 21 or later before running the game.
